verdict.rationale: Canny documents Autopilot, which automatically pulls feature requests out of call transcripts and support sources, roughly decluttering raw feedback. Its official MCP server lets an LLM dig into top themes and ARR impact across ideas to surface impactful opportunities. However, the opportunity analysis runs through an external LLM via MCP rather than a documented native AI insights feature, and the evidence is vendor marketing only. Missing for 10: documented native AI deduplication/merging and theme clustering, a built-in impact-ranking or opportunity-scoring feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to declutter raw feedback and surface the most impactful opportunities
